recentItems.title: Aigiri Nandini | JBL x Backstage Siblings | JBL Sounds Festive | SVF Music
recentItems.description:
This Pujo, Kolkata Sounds Festive with JBL
JBL x Backstage Siblings bring you a fresh take on the timeless Aigiri Nandini, a tribute to Maa Durga and to the city that celebrates her like no other. From misty mornings on the Hooghly to metro rides, pandal lights, dhaker taal and dhunuchi naach, this is Kolkata’s Durga Puja the way it feels: rooted in tradition and blending with the contemporary, louder than ever, and best celebrated together.
Because this season, JBL Partybox Encore 2 Plus helps make it Sound Like Pujo. 
Turn it up, gather your people, and let the festivities begin. 
Subho Sharodiya! 
Performed by: Backstage Siblings | Prachi & Raghav
Presented by: JBL India
Music Producer Kuntal De a.k.a GJ Storm
